description.value: Cliffside Cider is a small-batch cidery located in Squamish, BC, producing cider on-site at a unit on Second Avenue. Squamish sits at the gateway to the Sea-to-Sky corridor, making it a natural stop for cyclists riding between Vancouver and Whistler. No current web presence could be confirmed, so the operating status of this taproom is uncertain.
